name: coldpin
description: Inspect npx packages cold in memory, verify tarball-to-source parity, and pin verified pre-compromise releases or clean alternatives with zero execution.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect npx tools cold and pin clean anchors
interface.longDescription: Discover npm and npx tools safely without executing untrusted install scripts. Checks typosquatting, slopsquatting, OSV/OpenSSF malicious advisories, AST credential-exfiltration taint, tarball-to-source parity, and safe pre-compromise rollback anchors.
defaultPrompt: Find a clean npx tool for formatting JSON and verify its latest tarball.
Inspect this npm package for malware, lifecycle hooks, and tarball drift.
Check if this org repo is compromised and locate the latest clean release or alternative.
